title: Does not work
text: Does not work. Pump activates with photo eye but will not pick up product. I did charge the dispenser all night before trying it the next morning. I tried 2 different foaming soaps and many more things "pulling out the line and putting it back to make sure it was in good" tipping the bottle to every angle possible" grrr. The motor is just not strong enough to pull the soap. Save your money. Get a better hands free dispenser.
